description: Enter password values only through the owner-authenticated portal password form; MCP refuses raw password arguments. These legacy schema fields document the underlying operation, not permission to send secrets through MCP. Set a new root/administrator password on a VPS. Available for Proxmox VPS only. This REPLACES the current password, so anything logging in with the old one — a deploy script, a monitoring agent, a saved SSH session — stops working immediately; check with the customer before doing it. Prefer an SSH key where the customer has one. The new password is only as private as the channel you are talking over: generate a strong one, hand it over once, and do not repeat it back later. Minimum 8 characters. Requires the 'manage' scope. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. IRREVERSIBLE — takes two calls: the first returns a confirm_token and changes nothing, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and executes.

password.description: New root password, at least 8 characters. Keep it in an owner-authorized private credential channel; never repeat it into logs or shared content.

service_id.description: VPS service id (from impreza_list_services). Proxmox VPS only; basic Cloud VPS does not support this operation.

name: impreza_vps_reset_password
title: Reset VPS root password
